summary: Earlier draft was refused by the engine for an algebraic loop through `addNew`, `limiter`, `switchFreeze`, `switchSamplerIn` and `sampler`. Later draft inserted `resetDelay` fed by `switchOut` to break that cycle and rerouted its outputs to `addNew` and `switchFreeze` in place of `sampler`.

changes.title: Break algebraic loop with delay
changes.text: Added state-holding block `resetDelay` with input from `switchOut` and outputs to `addNew` and `switchFreeze`, replacing the direct feeds from `sampler` that were part of the reported direct-feedthrough cycle. This follows the engine remedy to insert a delay to break the loop.
